knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure says to clean and dry reusable tools, empty tanks by the authorised route, inspect filters, and record damage and outstanding faults.
Only serviceable equipment returns to clean storage. Faults are recorded and contaminated tools are segregated for reprocessing.
The core procedure says to return only serviceable equipment to clean storage, and to segregate contaminated tools for reprocessing.

practicalCriteria: Equipment is clean, dry, correctly stored and traceable for maintenance.
